title: Meeting
description: Syncslids meeting input. LLM: set title, name, items[].topic/description/durationMins. Leave cards empty — filled interactively.

title.description: Hero heading on the agenda slide, e.g. 'Q2 Planning'

name.description: Short label in the top bar, e.g. 'Weekly Sync · 2026-04-13'

items.description: Ordered agenda items, one slide each

topic.description: Agenda item title shown in the slide header and agenda list

description.description: One-line context shown beneath the topic

durationMins.description: Suggested timer for this item in minutes

cards.description: Pre-seeded outcome cards. Usually empty — the LLM may seed context cards if helpful.

$comment: Export format (output only, no presentation fields): { meeting, title, exported_at, items:[{ topic, cards:[{ title, notes }] }] }
